Architecture.md Revision 3 (frontier-hardened), author-directed: incorporated eight insights from sessions 40-47. (1) Decoupled formal_statement from a new definition_closure facet, keyed on declaration identity, so declaration remaps no longer perturb dependents. (2) Added the declaration-ownership rule. (3) Added Section 15.6, the mechanical Lean gate (full-diagnostics build with a warning allowlist, #print axioms on every mapped declaration, sorry-freeness, a derived lean_audit artifact), and corrected Sections 15.2/15.5 which had claimed these were 'part of the build' when the gate never invoked the compiler. (4) Added supersedes/reissue_reason to evidence records and split 'stale' into awaiting-re-audit vs superseded. (5) Documented layer assignment by block kind. (6) Added the extractor fail-closed policy (Section 12.1). (7) Added post-hoc declaration addition as hygiene mode 4 (Section 13.3). (8) Specified a single session orchestrator for derived views (Section 16.1), and recorded the auditor model / same-model share (Sections 11.4, 24.4). Change log gained Revision 3. This is a specification edit only: no block facet, evidence record, or derived view content changes; Architecture.md is not a hashed facet.

summary: Session 49: implemented the first Revision 3 spec gap. summary: Session 50: implemented the Revision 3 supersession vocabulary (Section 7.2/8.1). Added optional supersedes/reissue_reason fields to the evidence schema and evidence.py writer; validate_records self-test covers them. Implemented the superseded-vs-awaiting distinction in status.py and the staleness view, with a design correction made during implementation: the classification is layer-based (a stale record is superseded when its block/layer still has current evidence, awaiting only when the layer has no current evidence) rather than field-based, because a field-based rule mislabels the 23 legacy re-issues made before the fields existed. supersedes/reissue_reason remain provenance (successor id + reason). Result: staleness report now reads '23 of 82 stale (23 superseded, 0 awaiting)' instead of a false backlog. Architecture Sections 7.2/8.1 reworded to match. status_test and validate_records self-test extended; check_all 27/27.

details.design_decision: layer-based supersession classification; fields are provenance only
details.reason: field-based rule would mislabel legacy re-issues (E-000001..E-000013 etc.) as awaiting

summary: Session 51: implemented the last Revision 3 spec gap, the definition_closure facet split (Sections 6/12.3). lean_facets now hashes formal_statement as the declaration's own signature only, and emits a third facet definition_closure = {decls, hash} over the transitive declaration-level closure (keyed on declaration identity, not block membership). closure.py adds definition_closure to correspondence self-facets and merges it from blocks/formal.json; impact.py propagates a definition change to dependents' definition_closure; discrepancy/impact views derive block edges from the declaration graph. Added a remap-invariance regression test. Migration: the split changed every correspondence formal_statement hash, staling 16 current correspondence records (E-000041..E-000082); each was re-issued content-preservingly as E-000083..E-000098 with reissue_reason=facet-split and supersedes set, keeping the original transcripts/verdicts. Result: all layers pass, 0 awaiting, 39 superseded stale records. check_all 27/27.

summary: Session 54: formalized B-P008 (a Sigma-algebra is subfinal iff its underlying S-sorted set is subfinal) as Mslang.subfinalAlg_iff, the substantive counterpart of the Session 53 vocabulary. Proof: forward by bijectivity into a subalgebra of the one-element algebra (componentwise subsingleton); backward by exhibiting the image subalgebra Y (univ iff a component is nonempty, subalgebra because X's operations supply witnesses) and a sortwise bijection. Axioms: Classical.choice only (permitted). Mapped in lean/declarations.json; formal facets regenerated (41 mapped blocks). Evidence: E-000104 (verification build_ok) and E-000105 (correspondence equivalent; two-stage blind; transcript blocks/audits/B-P008-correspondence.md). No review layer (informal proof not separately audited, consistent with B-P002/B-R003). Frontier unmapped blocks 89 -> 88; check_all 27/27.
